units.title: SG-7.5 · Runner unit tests pass with Git, provider and clock mocked
Act: Confirm lock and per-attempt timeout behavior in Runner
Act: Confirm retry loop and budget condition in Runner
Act: Confirm approval gate and worktree cleanup paths in Runner
Act: Confirm report writing and error precedence in Runner.Run
Verify: Lock held and per-attempt timeout unit tests

tests.name: TestRunLockedKeepsForeignLock
tests.title: Run does not start and leaves the foreign lock in place when the World lock is already held
tests.scenario: Given a foreign process already holds the World lock file, When Run is called, Then it returns an error wrapping lock.ErrLocked, the lock file still exists, no execution record is stored and the agent never runs.

tests.name: TestRunTimeoutPerAttempt
tests.title: Each attempt gets its own timeout and retries stop after MaxRetries
tests.scenario: Given the agent blocks until its context ends, a 20ms timeout and one retry, When Run is called, Then the agent runs twice, each attempt ends with context.DeadlineExceeded, and Run returns an error wrapping context.DeadlineExceeded.

units.title: Verify: Retry limit and budget boundary unit tests

tests.name: TestRunZeroRetriesRunsOnce
tests.title: Run with zero retries runs the agent once and returns the error without ErrBudgetExceeded
tests.scenario: Given MaxRetries is 0, MaxBudget is 100 and the agent fails once; When Run is called; Then it returns an error, agent.calls is 1, returned Attempt is 1 and the error does not wrap ErrBudgetExceeded

tests.name: TestRunZeroBudgetUnlimited
tests.title: A zero MaxBudget never stops retries
tests.scenario: Given each call costs 100, MaxRetries is 2, MaxBudget is 0 and every call fails; When Run is called; Then the agent runs three times and the error does not wrap ErrBudgetExceeded

tests.name: TestRunBudgetEqualNotExceeded
tests.title: Spending exactly the budget does not count as exceeded
tests.scenario: Given each call costs 2.5, MaxRetries is 2, MaxBudget is 5.0 and every call fails; When Run is called; Then the agent runs three times and the error does not wrap ErrBudgetExceeded

units.title: Verify: Approval gate and worktree cleanup unit tests

tests.name: TestRunCleanup
tests.title: A successful run releases the lock and removes its worktree
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds and AutoPublish is true, When Run completes, Then the lock file is gone, the worktree is created and removed once under WorkRoot/EXEC-1, and the agent works in that directory
tests.detail: Failed before the Step 1 config fix (approval gate kept the worktree); passes after it.

tests.name: TestRunCreateWorktreeError
tests.title: A failing worktree creation fails the run before the agent starts
tests.scenario: Given the worktree Create call fails with 'no git', When Run is called, Then the error contains 'no git', the agent is never called and the stored status stays RUNNING
tests.detail: createFailTrees fake embeds fakeTrees and overrides Create.

tests.name: TestRunFailureRemovesWorktree
tests.title: A failed run with no retries removes its worktree and never publishes
tests.scenario: Given the agent fails once and MaxRetries is 0, When Run is called, Then the worktree is removed exactly once, the publisher is never called and Run returns an error
tests.detail: Passes in the individual run and in the combined run.

units.title: Verify: Report edge case unit tests

tests.name: TestRunReportDurationFromClock
tests.title: Report duration is derived from the injected clock
tests.scenario: Given an injected clock advancing one second per call, When Run succeeds with AutoPublish true and a reporter set, Then DurationMS > 0 and equals FinishedAt.Sub(StartedAt) in ms

tests.name: TestRunReporterErrorReturnedOnSuccess
tests.title: Reporter write failure is returned on a successful run
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds and the reporter fails with 'disk full', When Run is called, Then errors.Is(err, diskFull) is true

tests.name: TestRunReporterErrorDoesNotMaskRunError
tests.title: Run error is not masked by a reporter write failure
tests.scenario: Given the agent fails with 'boom' and MaxRetries 0 and the reporter fails with 'disk full', When Run is called, Then errors.Is(err, boom) is true and errors.Is(err, diskFull) is false

tests.name: TestRunNilReporter
tests.title: Run without a reporter completes without panic
tests.scenario: Given no reporter is set and the agent succeeds with AutoPublish true, When Run is called, Then err is nil

units.title: REQ · Lock held and per-attempt timeout are proven by unit tests
REQ · Retry limit and budget boundaries are proven by unit tests
REQ · Approval gate and worktree cleanup tests are correct and green
REQ · Report edge cases are proven with an injected clock and fake reporter
Evidence: Runner unit tests green with mocked Git, provider and clock
